notes.title: Idle Trillionaire - Mod Support Update
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="I-R2vrqattU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Release 3.15 includes[/p][p]- 🎉 Mod Support Added – You can now add and play with custom mods![/p][p]- ⏸️ Offline Progress Handling – Offline progress is now disabled when the - game is paused.[/p][p]- 🔁 Partial Prestige Resets – You can now reset to previously completed prestige levels.[/p][p]- ✍️ Bug Fixes – Various typo corrections for a cleaner experience.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]How to use mods:[/h2][p][/p][h3]To create a mod[/h3][list][*][p]Go to the main menu and click mods[/p][/*][*][p]Enter card details and click "Add Card"[/p][/*][*][p]When ready you can test your deck by clicking "Play Modded Deck"[/p][/*][/list][h3]Remove mods (restore vanilla cards)[/h3][list][*][p]Go to the main menu and click mods[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking "Play Game (Without Mods)"[/p][/*][/list][h3]Share a mod[/h3][list][*][p]When a modded deck is loaded, you can export the mod as either a file or a mod-string[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Export Mod String" or "Save Mod File"[/p][/*][*][p]Share your mod with a friend or in the community[/p][/*][/list][h3]Load a Mod from a mod-string[/h3][list][*][p]Go to the main menu and click mods[/p][/*][*][p]paste a mod-string into the text field and click "Import Mod String"[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Play Modded Deck"[/p][/*][/list][h3]Load a Mod from a mod-file[/h3][list][*][p]Go to the main menu and click mods[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Load Mod File"[/p][/*][*][p]choose your mod file[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Play Modded Deck"[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, or want to share a mod please comment in the steam discussions or on [url="https://https://discord.com/invite/Tr7yVM7ust"]discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

- 🔁 Partial Prestige Resets – You can now reset to previously completed prestige levels.

notes.title: Prestige Buffs and Tutorial Cards
notes.content:
You've spoken and I like what I heard! 

Happy 2025 all you greedy trillionaires! Here is what's new in Idle Trillionaire for version 3.08.

Change Notes:

- Added missing "Buy Russia" card and Tutorial Cards.
- Retain your hidden cards when you Prestige Up.
- Offline progress now scales with prestige level. 
- Fixed a game load bug that occasionally caused glitches.


[h3]What does this mean for offline progress on prestige runs? [/h3]
Prestige 1: 1 hour real time is = 100 hours game time
Prestige 2: 1 hour real time is = 200 hours game time
Prestige 3: 1 hour real time is = 300 hours game time
Prestige 4: 1 hour real time is = 400 hours game time
etc....

As always, thank you for your amazing feedback and ideas!

notes.title: Live Forever - Late Prestige Update
notes.content:
I was recently messaged by a trillionaire who was at prestige 20! 

While this was amazing to hear, it brought to my attention the need to expand upon the late prestige levels where time rate was capped at 1 in game day each tick (200ms).

New in this update:
[list]
[*] Infinitely increase time rate by an extra day for every prestige over 10.
[/list]


What this means? 
[list]
[*] Prestige 10 > 1 day per tick
[*] Prestige 11> 2 day per tick
[*] Prestige 12> 3 day per tick
[*] Prestige 13> 4 day per tick
[*] Prestige 14> 5 day per tick
[*] Prestige 15> 6 day per tick
... and so on
[/list]

Go on, you are already a god. Live for a thousand years... a million?  a trillion!?

tags.feature: [*] Infinitely increase time rate by an extra day for every prestige over 10.

notes.title: Hide / Trash Cards
notes.content:
There is a (not recommended) review on steam that wished they could refuse cards that felt like they made no sense in an effort to clean up the board.

Well here it is! 
- cards can now be trashed by clicking the X
- trashed cards can later be restored from the main menu

notes.title: Adds Toggle for Card Warnings
notes.content:
Players deserve choice... If your a thinker the default "Card Warnings Off" will suit you. 
[list]
[*]"Easy Mode" toggle added to show/hide dangerous card warnings (default off).
[*]Performance optimization: Starting at Prestige 5 instead of increasing tick-speed (CPU expensive); increase hours passed per tick.
[*]Ex. At Prestige 9, 12 hours pass each tick. At Prestige 10, a full day passes each tick.
[/list]

notes.title: Dangerous Card Warnings Update
notes.content:
Some of the Trillionaires have reported accidentally clicking cards that ended their run early. I don't believe a trillionaire should have to think too hard in life, things should be offered up on a silver platter!

As such look out for these warnings on cards that are liable to ruin your day. Maybe it's still worth it, but be careful and consider your options.

- Adds "Living Beyond Means" warning to dangerous cards
- Adds "Cashflow Risk" warning to dangerous cards
- Adds "Bankruptcy Risk" warning to dangerous cards
- Adds "Daily Sadness" warning to dangerous cards
- Adds "Devastating Event" warning to dangerous cards
- Adds "Depressed" and "Suicide Risk" warning in header when losing happy daily

So go ahead, mindlessly spam click cards so long as there is no big red warning. After all we're here to get rich fast and every aspiring trillionaire needs an advisor to warn them that perhaps making that "shady back alley deal" is a REALLY bad idea (at least until you're super rich).

Furthermore:
- Adds text to the Reset Button so it is more clear that you have the option to preserve your prestige level
- Randomize Slots - up to 30% bonus

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Hello Trillionaires!  Thanks for playing. I'm just an everyday average normal person who likes to make games. So glad your here!

[list]
[*]Adds lots of new cards
[*]Redesigns top area to better use space on wide screens
[*]Adds Game Over notification and better handles game over
[*]Fixes typos and balances some cards
[/list]


If you have found a bug - typo - great card idea - or just have any idea you would like to see in the game, I would love to hear from you. Join the discussion in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tr7yVM7ust]official discord[/url]:

If you enjoy this game, I would really appreciate a review as that would help a small dev like me immensely.

Keep an eye out for future content updates.
